riddles.question: The more of me you discover, the less you actually know. I outweigh everything you can see, yet you cannot see me at all. What am I?
riddles.explanation: The unknown. The more you learn, the more you realize how much you don't know (Socratic paradox).

riddles.question: Mara swept the corridor of the great lighthouse every evening. She was never allowed to light the lamp - that was the Keeper's sacred duty. But on the night the Keeper fell ill, the ships below began to cry out in the storm. Mara climbed the winding stairs with a torch in trembling hands. The light she kindled that night guided a hundred sailors home. They called her a hero, but Mara only smiled: the lamp had always been ready; it simply needed someone brave enough to light it. / What does this story suggest about courage?
options: Courage is acting when it is needed most
Courage is a gift passed down by the Keeper
Only trained Keepers are ever truly brave
The lamp granted Mara magical powers
riddles.explanation: Mara's heroism came from stepping up when the moment demanded it - courage is showing up when it counts.
